US Marks 250th Anniversary Amidst Domestic and International Scrutiny

The United States is commemorating its 250th anniversary, a milestone marked by celebrations and reflections on its history and future. While some events proceeded despite challenging weather, the occasion is also being viewed through lenses of internal division, historical reckoning, and its standing on the global stage. International observers and domestic groups are sharing their perspectives, with some raising concerns about the nation's direction.
